verdict.rationale:
Portkey's core AI Gateway functionality (routing, fallbacks, caching, retries, virtual keys, model catalog access via `@provider-slug/model-name`) is inherently API-driven, supporting strong API-native use for inference workflows. However, there's no evidence of a documented admin/management API (creating configs, budgets, rate limits, guardrails programmatically) — the openapi spec probe returned 404s at all candidate paths, and features like log sharing, log filtering by Config ID, and budget/rate-limit setup are described without confirming API-equivalent access outside the UI.
missing for 10: explicit admin/management REST API docs for budgets/rate-limits/guardrails/configs, a discoverable OpenAPI spec, and independent confirmation that dashboard-only features (log sharing links, notification setup) are also API-accessible.
